description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for message command implementations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages message serialization, validation, and common behavior for commands related to messages, primarily focusing on handling the ThingId and Message objects.

classes.name: AbstractMessageCommand
classes.description: An abstract base class for message commands that encapsulates common logic for handling messages, including validation, serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: AbstractMessageCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with type, thing ID, message, and headers, validating the thing ID from the message.

methods.name: validateThingId
methods.description: Validates that the provided ThingId matches the one in the message; throws exception if mismatched.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload into a JSON object, including headers and message content.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Static method that deserializes a Message object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the command object based on its fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this command and another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method to assist in equality comparison, ensuring correct type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command, including superclass info, thingId, and message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Abstract method to set Ditto headers; implementation expected in subclasses.
